title: 3DTILES_layers node extension
description: glTF extension that assigns a node to a layer.

layer.description: The index of the layer that this node belongs to. The value is an index into the array of `layers` that is defined in the document-level `3DTILES_layers` extension. If there is no document-level `3DTILES_layers` extension and this asset is referenced by an external asset, it uses the `layers` of the referencing asset, recursively, until `layers` is found.
